# Crafting reference

The crafter, recipe book, crafting skills and station components, the recipe, category, station and skill assets, and the effect that teaches a recipe. For how to use it, see [Crafting](../modules/crafting.md).

## VtUnitCrafter

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Crafting → VtUnitCrafter**.

Per-unit crafter — validates recipes, consumes ingredients, produces outputs, grants skill XP, drives the timed-craft state machine. The crafting actor.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsCrafting { get; }` | True when a timed craft is currently in flight. |
| `VtRecipeDefinition CurrentRecipe { get; }` | The recipe currently being crafted, or null when idle. |
| `float CurrentProgress01 { get; }` | Progress of the current timed craft as a 0..1 fraction. 0 when idle. |
| `float CurrentRemainingSeconds { get; }` | Seconds remaining on the current timed craft. 0 when idle. |
| `IVtCostSource CostSource { get; }` | Where ingredients are taken from: the source set with `SetCostSource`, else the `VtSharedStash` that serves this unit, else its own bag. Tools in `Required Items` are always checked in the unit's own bag. The crafted item goes where the recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.outputDestination` says. A timed craft pays when it finishes, from the source chosen when it started, even if the unit has since left a stash's zone; when that source no longer holds the ingredients, or the stash was disabled, the craft fails with `VtCraftFailureReason.MissingIngredients` and produces nothing. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition> OnCraftStarted` | Fires when a craft begins — instant or timed. Args: the recipe. Subscribers spawn the craft-bar UI / play start animation. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition, float> OnCraftProgress` | Fires every Update tick while a timed craft is in flight. Args: (recipe, progress01) where progress01 is 0..1. Skipped for instant crafts (they fire Started + Completed in one tick). |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition> OnCraftCompleted` | Fires after a craft successfully completes (instant or timed). At this point ingredients are consumed, output is granted, XP is credited. Args: the recipe. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition> OnCraftCancelled` | Fires when a timed craft is cancelled before completion. Args: the recipe. No consume / produce / XP grant. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition, VtCraftFailureReason> OnCraftFailed` | Fires when a `TryCraft` call refuses. Args: (recipe, reason). Recipe may be null when reason is `VtCraftFailureReason.RecipeNull`. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache sibling components. Idempotent — safe to call any number of times. Public for the late-attach contract. |
| `void SetCostSource(IVtCostSource source)` | Take ingredients from `source`, such as a pool of your own. Null goes back to the default choice described on `CostSource`. |
| `bool IsAvailable(VtRecipeDefinition recipe, VtCraftingStation station, out VtCraftFailureReason reason)` | Run every prereq for `recipe` at `station`, including standing within the station's interact radius. Returns true + `VtCraftFailureReason.None` when the recipe is craftable; returns false + the first failing reason otherwise. Pure query — never mutates. |
| `bool TryCraft(VtRecipeDefinition recipe, VtCraftingStation station, out VtCraftFailureReason reason)` | Start crafting `recipe` at `station`. Instant recipes (craftSeconds == 0) execute immediately. Timed recipes start a per-frame Update countdown; the crafter fires `OnCraftStarted` + `OnCraftProgress` while in flight, then `OnCraftCompleted` + consume + produce + XP grant when remainingSeconds hits 0. Returns true on accept, false + populated reason on refusal (also fires `OnCraftFailed`). |
| `bool CancelCraft()` | Cancel the active timed craft. No-op when idle. Returns false when nothing was crafting; true on cancel. Fires `OnCraftCancelled`; no consume / produce / XP grant. |
| `void ApplyCraftStateFromNet(VtRecipeDefinition active, float remaining)` | Net-replication entry point. Mirrors the authority's active timed-craft state. Bypasses the authority gate. Fires `OnCraftStarted` when starting fresh, `OnCraftCancelled` when the active recipe is cleared. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the active timed craft by `deltaTime` seconds; completes it (consume, produce, XP, `OnCraftCompleted`) once the timer drains. Authority-only. The only time input this component consumes; `Update` forwards `Time.deltaTime`. |

## VtUnitRecipeBook

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Crafting → VtUnitRecipeBook**.

Per-unit recipe book — tracks the explicitly-learned recipes for the holder. Recipes with `VtRecipeDefinition.learnedByDefault` = true don't need to be in the book; they're always considered learned. The book stores only the rare / quest-locked / scroll-taught recipes.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyCollection<VtRecipeDefinition> LearnedRecipes { get; }` | Live read-only view of every explicitly-learned recipe. Does NOT include `VtRecipeDefinition.learnedByDefault` recipes — query `IsLearned` for the combined check. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition> OnRecipeLearned` | Fires after a recipe is added to the book via `Learn`. Args: the learned recipe. |
| `event Action<VtRecipeDefinition> OnRecipeForgotten` | Fires after a recipe is removed via `Forget`. Args: the forgotten recipe. |
| `void Initialize()` | Idempotent init for the late-attach contract — no per-instance state to seed, but the contract is uniform across the package. |
| `bool IsLearned(VtRecipeDefinition recipe)` | True when the recipe is craftable from a learning perspective: it's `VtRecipeDefinition.learnedByDefault` OR has been explicitly learned. Other prereqs (level, skill, ingredients) are checked separately by `VtUnitCrafter.IsAvailable`. |
| `bool Learn(VtRecipeDefinition recipe)` | Add a recipe to the book. Authority-gated. Returns false if null, already learned, or replica side. Fires `OnRecipeLearned` on success. |
| `bool Forget(VtRecipeDefinition recipe)` | Remove a recipe from the book — admin / quest-flow. Authority-gated. Returns false if null or not learned. Fires `OnRecipeForgotten` on success. |
| `void ApplyRecipeBookFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtRecipeDefinition> snapshot)` | Net-replication entry point. Replaces the learned set with the authoritative snapshot. Bypasses the authority gate. Fires `OnRecipeLearned` / `OnRecipeForgotten` only for entries whose presence actually differs from before the mirror. |

## VtUnitCraftingSkills

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Crafting → VtUnitCraftingSkills**.

Per-unit crafting-skill ledger — one (level, xp) state per `VtCraftingSkillDefinition` the holder progresses on. Mirrors `VtUnitLevel` in shape but tracks N independent skills instead of one global level.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<VtCraftingSkillDefinition, int, int> OnSkillLeveledUp` | Fires once after every `AddXp` / `SetLevel` call that produces at least one level-up. Args: (skill, oldLevel, newLevel). Multi-level jumps fire once with the full old → new range. |
| `event Action<VtCraftingSkillDefinition, int, int, int> OnSkillXpChanged` | Fires after any mutation to a skill's XP, AFTER any level-ups. Args: (skill, currentLevel, currentXp, xpToNext). Use for skill-bar UI. |
| `void Initialize()` | Idempotent init for the late-attach contract. |
| `void CopySnapshotTo(List<VtCraftingSkillSnapshot> target)` | Append one snapshot per skill the holder has progressed on. Used by save and replication. |
| `int GetLevel(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill)` | Current level in `skill`. Returns 1 for skills the holder hasn't progressed on yet — every player implicitly starts at level 1 in every skill. |
| `int GetXp(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill)` | Accumulated XP toward the next level in `skill`. Always less than `GetXpToNextLevel`. |
| `int GetXpToNextLevel(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill)` | XP needed to advance from `GetLevel` to the next level. 0 when the skill is at its `VtCraftingSkillDefinition.maxLevel` or the curve is missing. |
| `bool IsMaxLevel(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill)` | True when the skill is at `VtCraftingSkillDefinition.maxLevel`. |
| `void AddXp(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill, int amount)` | Credit XP to a skill. Authority-gated. Drains through the curve thresholds, firing `OnSkillLeveledUp` once per AddXp call that crosses any level boundary (multi-level jumps fire one event with the full range). |
| `void SetLevel(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill, int level)` | Force-set a skill's level. Authority-gated. Resets XP to 0. Used by save-restore, admin commands, mentor systems. |
| `void Reset(VtCraftingSkillDefinition skill)` | Wipe a skill's XP back to 0 but keep current level. Authority-gated. |
| `void ApplySkillsFromNet(IReadOnlyList<VtCraftingSkillSnapshot> snapshot)` | Net-replication entry point. Replaces every skill's state with the authoritative snapshot. Bypasses the authority gate. Fires `OnSkillLeveledUp` for skills whose level changed and `OnSkillXpChanged` for skills whose XP changed. |

## VtCraftingStation

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Crafting → VtCraftingStation**.

Scene-placed crafting station — anvil, alchemy table, cookpot, etc. Players reach it through the normal right-click, walk-to and interact flow, with no extra input wiring.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Station Type (`stationType`) | [VtRecipeStationDefinition](#vtrecipestationdefinition) | None |  | Station type — recipes that require this type can be crafted while interacting with this station. Required. |
| Interact Radius (`interactRadius`) | `float` | 3 | ≥ 0 | Distance (world units) within which the player can interact with this station. The walk-to-pickup flow stops here. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<VtUnit, VtRecipeStationDefinition> OnStationOpened` | Fires when a player successfully interacts with this station. Args: (player, stationType). Consumer UI subscribes to render the recipe-list window filtered by stationType. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the sibling `VtUnit`. Idempotent — safe to call any number of times. Public for the late-attach contract. |

## VtRecipeDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Crafting → Recipe Definition**.

Authored crafting recipe: what it consumes and produces, where and how long it takes, and who may craft it. A unit crafts it through its `VtUnitCrafter`.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'recipe.<area>.<flavor>' (e.g. 'recipe.smithing.iron_sword'). Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI display name shown in the recipe-list window. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Recipe description shown in the crafting UI tooltip. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Icon for the recipe list. Optional; a list usually shows the output item's icon when this is empty. |
| Icon Id (`iconId`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name of an icon from the package's icon set (VtIcons), used when Icon is empty. Optional. |
| Sort Weight (`sortWeight`) | `int` | 0 |  | Order within its category: lower comes first. Recipes with the same weight keep their list order. |

#### Classification

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Category (`category`) | [VtRecipeCategoryDefinition](#vtrecipecategorydefinition) | None |  | Recipe category — drives recipe-list UI sort + tinting. Optional — null categorizes the recipe as 'uncategorized'. |
| Station (`station`) | [VtRecipeStationDefinition](#vtrecipestationdefinition) | None |  | Required station type. Null = craft anywhere (no station required). Non-null = the player must be interacting with a VtCraftingStation whose stationType matches this reference. |

#### Inputs & Output

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inputs (`inputs`) | [VtRecipeIngredient](#vtrecipeingredient)[] | Empty |  | Ingredients consumed on a successful craft. Every entry must be in the crafter's cost source in the listed count before TryCraft accepts: its own bag, or the shared stash that pays for it. On completion they're removed. |
| Output (`output`) | [VtRecipeOutput](#vtrecipeoutput) | — |  | Item produced on a successful craft. |
| Output Destination (`outputDestination`) | [VtCraftOutputDestination](#vtcraftoutputdestination) | `CrafterBag` |  | Crafter Bag puts the output in the crafter's bag. Cost Source puts it back where the ingredients came from: the shared stash when one paid, else the crafter's bag. Use Cost Source for materials made from materials. |
| Craft Seconds (`craftSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | How long the craft takes, in seconds. 0 = instant (consume + produce same frame). > 0 = timed; the crafter fires Started / Progress(t) / Completed events. One craft active at a time per crafter; consumer wires queueing if needed. |

#### Prerequisites

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Level (`requiredLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum holder level. 0 = no level gate. Checked against VtUnitLevel.Level; units without a level component are treated as level 1. |
| Required Completed Quests (`requiredCompletedQuests`) | [VtQuestDefinition](quests.md#vtquestdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Quests that must be in the TurnedIn state before this recipe becomes craftable. Empty = no quest gate. |
| Required Items (`requiredItems`) | [VtRecipeIngredient](#vtrecipeingredient)[] | Empty |  | Items the crafter MUST hold to use this recipe but that AREN'T consumed (Crafter's Tools, Hammer, Recipe Book reagent). Distinguished from inputs[] which ARE consumed. Empty = no required-tool gate. |
| Required Unlock (`requiredUnlock`) | [VtUnlockDefinition](unlocks.md#vtunlockdefinition) | None |  | Unlock that must be owned, by the crafter or the shared stash that pays for it. Empty = no unlock gate. |

#### Skill Gate

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Skill (`requiredSkill`) | [VtCraftingSkillDefinition](#vtcraftingskilldefinition) | None |  | Crafting skill this recipe requires. Optional — null = no skill gate (and no XP grant on completion). |
| Required Skill Level (`requiredSkillLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum level in the requiredSkill. 0 = any level passes; ignored when requiredSkill is null. |

#### Unlock & Reward

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Learned By Default (`learnedByDefault`) | `bool` | On |  | If true, every player can craft this recipe by default (no Learn step required). If false, the recipe must be added to the player's VtUnitRecipeBook first — typically by consuming a recipe-scroll item with VtLearnRecipeEffect. |
| Xp Grant (`xpGrant`) | `int` | 10 | ≥ 0 | XP credited to requiredSkill on a successful craft. Ignored when requiredSkill is null. Set to 0 to skip the XP grant. |

## VtRecipeCategoryDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Crafting → Recipe Category**.

Authored recipe category — Weapons / Consumables / Food / Engineering / custom. Each `VtRecipeDefinition` references one category; the category drives UI sort order, tinting, and any consumer-side feature gating (filter the recipe-list window by category tab). Asset-per-tier and consumer-extensible — same shape as `VtItemRarityDefinition` / `VtQuestCategoryDefinition`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'recipe.category.weapons', 'recipe.category.consumables'. Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | UI display name. E.g. 'Weapons', 'Consumables', 'Food'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty | Designer-facing description. Doesn't affect runtime. |
| Sort Weight (`sortWeight`) | `int` | 0 | Sort priority for recipe-list UI ordering. Lower = appears first. Convention: Weapons 0, Consumables 100, Food 200, Engineering 300. Leave gaps for inserts. |
| Color (`color`) | `Color` | `#FFFFFFFF` | UI tint applied to the recipe's name / category label in the crafting window. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None | Optional category icon shown in the recipe-list UI. Null for no icon. |
| Icon Id (`iconId`) | `string` | Empty | Name of an icon from the package's icon set (VtIcons), used when Icon is empty. Optional. |

## VtRecipeStationDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Crafting → Recipe Station**.

Authored crafting-station type — Anvil / AlchemyTable / Cookpot / custom. Pure marker: no behavior, just an identity. Recipes tag a station type via `VtRecipeDefinition.station`; `VtCraftingStation` instances on scene-placed entities declare their type; the crafter matches them on `VtUnitCrafter.TryCraft`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'station.anvil', 'station.alchemy_table'. Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | UI display name. E.g. 'Anvil', 'Alchemy Table', 'Cookpot'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty | Designer-facing description. Doesn't affect runtime. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None | Optional station icon for crafting-window header. Null for no icon. |

## VtCraftingSkillDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Crafting → Crafting Skill**.

Authored crafting skill — Smithing / Alchemy / Cooking / Engineering / custom. Each skill is its own progression track on `VtUnitCraftingSkills`; recipes can require a minimum level in a specific skill, and successful crafts grant XP to the recipe's skill via `VtRecipeDefinition.xpGrant`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'skill.smithing', 'skill.alchemy'. Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI display name. E.g. 'Smithing', 'Alchemy', 'Cooking'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Designer-facing description. |
| Sort Weight (`sortWeight`) | `int` | 0 |  | Sort priority for skill-list UI ordering. Lower = appears first. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Optional skill icon for the skill-list UI. |
| Color (`color`) | `Color` | `#FFFFFFFF` |  | UI tint applied to the skill's name in the crafting / skills windows. Default white. |
| Xp Curve (`xpCurve`) | [VtXpCurveDefinition](leveling.md#vtxpcurvedefinition) | None |  | XP-to-next-level curve, the same asset type characters level on. Share one curve across skills, or give a skill its own for different pacing. Required. |
| Max Level (`maxLevel`) | `int` | 60 | ≥ 1 | Maximum level reachable on this skill. AddXp at maxLevel drops excess silently. Should usually mirror the curve's maxLevel. |

## VtLearnRecipeEffect

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Abilities → Effects → Learn Recipe**. Inherits [VtAbilityEffect](abilities.md#vtabilityeffect).

Ability effect: add a `VtRecipeDefinition` to the caster's `VtUnitRecipeBook` on cast. The mechanism behind recipe-scroll items — author a recipe scroll as a regular `VtItemDefinition` with `consumeOnUse = true` and a one-effect `useAbility` that contains this effect; using the scroll learns the recipe and disposes the scroll.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recipe (`recipe`) | [VtRecipeDefinition](#vtrecipedefinition) | None | Recipe added to the caster's recipe book on cast. Required — effect silently no-ops if null. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override void Execute(in VtAbilityContext ctx)` | Adds `recipe` to the caster's `VtUnitRecipeBook`. Does nothing when the caster has no recipe book. |

## VtRecipeIngredient

Serializable struct.

One row in a recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.inputs` or `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredItems` array. Pairs an item with a count.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item required by this entry. For inputs[]: consumed on craft. For requiredItems[]: must be in inventory but NOT consumed. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 1 | How many of this item are required. Stackable items count across stacks via VtUnitInventory.GetCount. |

## VtRecipeOutput

Serializable struct.

What a recipe produces on a successful craft: one item and a count.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Item (`item`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition) | None |  | Item produced on a successful craft. Required — recipe silently no-ops if null. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 1 | How many copies are added to the crafter's inventory on success. Stackable items merge; non-stackable each take a slot. |

## Enums

### VtCraftFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitCrafter.IsAvailable` check or `VtUnitCrafter.TryCraft` call refused. Surfaced via the `out` param on those calls and the `VtUnitCrafter.OnCraftFailed` event so consumer UI can render a precise "you can't craft this because…" message.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The check passed — recipe is craftable / craft succeeded. |
| `RecipeNull` | The recipe argument was null. |
| `NotLearned` | The crafter doesn't know this recipe yet (not `learnedByDefault` + not in the unit's `VtUnitRecipeBook`). |
| `MissingIngredients` | The unit's inventory doesn't hold enough of one or more `VtRecipeDefinition.inputs` ingredients. |
| `MissingRequiredItems` | The unit's inventory doesn't hold one or more `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredItems` tools (must-have but not consumed — e.g. Crafter's Tools). |
| `WrongStation` | The recipe requires a station the player isn't using (null station or wrong type). |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's `VtUnitLevel.Level` is below `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredLevel`. |
| `SkillTooLow` | The unit's `VtUnitCraftingSkills.GetLevel` for the recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredSkill` is below `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredSkillLevel`. |
| `MissingPrereqQuests` | One or more `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredCompletedQuests` haven't been turned in yet. |
| `AlreadyCrafting` | A timed craft is already active. Cancel it first or wait for it to complete. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Replica side refused the mutation; only authority can craft. |
| `NoCrafterComponent` | The unit doesn't carry a `VtUnitCrafter` component. Returned by external helpers; the crafter itself never emits this since it can only be invoked when present. |
| `TooFarFromStation` | The crafter is farther from the station than its interact radius allows. |
| `Locked` | The recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredUnlock` is not owned. |
| `InventoryFull` | The output would go into the crafter's bag and the bag has no room for it, even after the ingredients are taken out. |

### VtCraftOutputDestination

Where a `VtRecipeDefinition`'s output goes. Serialized as int; append only.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `CrafterBag` | Into the crafter's own bag, or into what paid when the crafter has no bag. |
| `CostSource` | Back into what paid for the ingredients: a shared stash when one served the crafter, else the crafter's own bag. Planks cut at camp go into the team's pool, planks cut in the wild into the pack. |
